cases.name: Samantha Samih Farah
cases.about:
Her obituary said, "Samantha was such a sweet baby, and she was tremendously close with her mother Tracy. Samantha went to Forest Hills Montessori School from the ages of 3 to 4, then went to Saint Pius Catholic school from kindergarten through eighth grade. Samantha then attended Carman Ainsworth, and graduated with her Associates Degree in Administration and was finishing up on her bachelor’s degree, shortly before her passing.

Samantha was a loving and devoted mother to her beautiful one year old daughter, Aliyah. Being a mother was her life's greatest joy, and she really enjoyed playing around with Michael and Kaitlynn, doing Snapchat videos and dancing.

She loved and enjoyed reading, going to the beach, and animals. She loved the late pop-singer Selena and enjoyed fishing with her big brother. She also enjoyed many sports such as, soccer, volleyball, basketball, ballet, and enjoyed having piano lessons early on in life."
cases.narrative:
A resident at her apartment complex called 911 to report that she saw a man dragging a woman’s body to the dumpster. The resident told police that she screamed at the man, saying: “What are you doing?” Two maintenance workers at the complex heard her cry. They left a nearby maintenance shed and saw him walking away from the dumpster. They looked inside and saw Samantha’s body. She had suffered “significant trauma” to her face and upper body. The medical examiner’s office told investigators that she was stabbed several times in the neck.
